recommendations.recommendation: Recognize filial piety as the root of all virtue and the source of moral teaching.
recommendations.rationale: The ancient kings used this perfect virtue to bring harmony to the realm, so that high and low bore no resentment.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Do not injure your body, hair, or skin, since you received them from your parents.
recommendations.rationale: Keeping intact the body received from parents is the beginning of filial piety.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
reasoning

recommendations.recommendation: Establish yourself, practice the Way, and make your name known so as to bring glory to your parents.
recommendations.rationale: Honoring one's parents through one's own achievement and reputation is the culmination of filial piety.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Show utmost reverence to your parents in daily life and joy when caring for them.
recommendations.rationale: Confucius lists these among the duties by which a filial son serves his parents.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Show deep anxiety and care when your parents are ill.
recommendations.rationale: This is one of the 5 duties of filial service named by Confucius.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Mourn your parents with genuine grief and offer sacrifices to them with solemnity.
recommendations.rationale: Grief in mourning and solemnity in sacrifice complete the duties owed to parents in life and death.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Observe 3 years of mourning, but do not let grief ruin your health, and do not fast more than 3 days.
recommendations.rationale: The sages set limits so the dead do not harm the living and the people know mourning has an end.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
reasoning
recommendations.conditions: grief must not endanger life or health
recommendations.argued_against: excessive mourning that destroys the mourner

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid pride in a high position, insubordination in a low one, and quarreling among equals.
recommendations.rationale: Pride brings ruin, insubordination brings punishment, and quarreling brings violence; then even daily feasts for parents would still be unfilial.
rationale_type: practical consequences
authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: those who feed parents well while endangering themselves through bad conduct

recommendations.recommendation: Carry the devotion you show your father into loyal service of your ruler.
recommendations.rationale: Filial devotion to a father transfers naturally into loyalty to a ruler, so the filial make good subjects.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
reasoning

recommendations.recommendation: Be respectful to your elder brothers and extend that deference to all elders.
recommendations.rationale: Fraternal respect at home becomes proper deference to elders and superiors in society.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
reasoning

recommendations.recommendation: Remonstrate with your father or ruler when they act wrongly instead of simply obeying.
recommendations.rationale: Obeying a father's every command is not filial; a son or minister who remonstrates keeps his father or ruler from unrighteousness.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
reasoning
recommendations.conditions: when the father or ruler does something unrighteous
recommendations.argued_against: the idea that blind obedience is filial piety

recommendations.recommendation: As a commoner, follow the seasons, use the land well, and be careful and frugal so you can support your parents.
recommendations.rationale: This is the filial piety appropriate to the common people.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: As a ruler, love and revere your own parents so you will not treat others with hatred or contempt, and teach the people by example.
recommendations.rationale: The ruler's filial love extends to all people and transforms the realm.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
reasoning

recommendations.recommendation: As a feudal lord, stay humble though high and frugal though rich, so as to keep your position and wealth.
recommendations.rationale: Humility and restraint preserve rank and wealth and keep one's state at peace.
rationale_type: practical consequences
authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: pride and extravagance in the powerful

recommendations.recommendation: As a minister, wear only the clothing, speak only the words, and follow only the conduct sanctioned by the former kings.
recommendations.rationale: Following the former kings' standards preserves the ancestral temple and the minister's position.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: When serving a ruler, think of being loyal while in office and of correcting your faults when you withdraw; promote his good and correct his bad.
recommendations.rationale: This creates mutual affection between superior and subordinate.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
practical consequences

recommendations.recommendation: Regard unfiliality as the greatest of all crimes.
recommendations.rationale: Among the 3,000 offenses covered by the 5 punishments, none is greater than lack of filial piety.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: those who coerce rulers, reject the sages, or disregard filial piety

recommendations.recommendation: Govern through filial piety, not neglecting even widows, orphans, and the humblest subjects.
recommendations.rationale: The enlightened kings of old ruled this way and gained the joy of all people and peace in the realm.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
practical consequences
